title: Understanding Fold and Bluff in Texas Hold'em Poker
summaryJa: テキサスホールデムの「フォールド」は自分のハンドを降りることで、「ブラフ」は弱いハンドで他のプレイヤーを騙す戦略です。この二つの基本的な用語を理解することでポーカーの楽しさが増します。
segments: Texas Hold'em poker has many important words to learn. Two common words are fold and bluff.
These words help players understand the game better. Let me explain what each word means and how players use them.
Fold means to stop playing your hand. When you fold, you give up your cards and leave the game for that round.
You lose any money you already put in the pot. Why do players fold?
When your cards are not good, it is smart to fold. This saves your money for a better hand later.
For example, you have two low cards. The player before you bets a lot of money.
You decide to fold. You put your cards down and save your money.
Bluff is different from fold. A bluff means you bet with a weak hand to trick other players.
You want them to think your cards are very good. Then they fold their cards.
You win the pot even though your hand is not the best. For example, you have bad cards.
But you bet a large amount. Another player thinks you have very good cards.
They get scared and fold. You win the money in the pot.
Good poker players use fold and bluff at the right times. Folding too much means you never win pots.
But bluffing too much means other players will not believe you. Smart players balance these two moves.
They fold when the time is right. They bluff sometimes but not always.
This helps them win more games.
